name: Look up member and read balances
description: Logs into the CreditVantage servicing console, searches for a member by ID, opens their record, and reports current Savings and Checking balances.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: Core member/account-holder ID to look up.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Extracting the Savings account balance for member ID 12345 from the member detail screen

outputs.name: checking_balance
outputs.description: Extracting the Checking account balance for member ID 12345 from the member detail screen
